scope: Exploratory foreground power profile of the isolated Qwen4 Q3 harness; not battery-life or catalogue approval

setupVerification.powerGuards: New UIKit battery and notification paths are build-verified; existing eight native tests do not exercise these UI notifications. Charging-refusal receipt requested separately.
setupVerification.transportCaution: Readiness transfer was slow. Charging-admission receipt transfers timed out at 30 and 60 seconds; lock-state query timed out at 15 seconds, so current lock state is unknown. Final plain idle launch succeeded. Charging-refusal behavior has not been corroborated by the missing receipt. Verify connectivity/readiness again before starting a measured workload.

capturePreflight.finding: PID attachment works; app-name attachment failed. SystemPowerLevel, ProcessSubsystemPowerImpact, charging and thermal tables export. System discharge is zero while charging and must not be interpreted as zero consumption.
capturePreflight.exportLimit: Some Swift-backed tables omit column labels in XML. Do not guess the meaning of unlabelled app-impact columns. System percent-per-hour and brightness have explicit engineering types.

eligibility: Unplugged from USB and MagSafe, battery >=30%, nominal thermals, Low Power Mode off. Keep same Wi-Fi, brightness, app foreground and other device conditions. Do not change user settings automatically.
workload: Existing eight-turn long-chat fixture, 2048 context, 256-token output cap, actual generated history, same pins/sampling, 30-second inter-turn pauses

phases.name: attach-wait
phases.measurement: Excluded; attach Instruments by verified app PID

phases.name: workload
phases.seconds: actual bounded eight-turn duration, previously about 270
phases.measurement: Includes hashes, loads, generation, export, and reading pauses

collection: Run retest_phone.py --long-chat --power-profile and attach xctrace Power Profiler by the current process ID during the initial 45-second allowance. Cap tracing at 10 minutes and stop after the suite ends. Export power/charging/thermal tables, TOC, native results and power-* phase markers. Reject missing baseline/workload coverage rather than extrapolating it.
markers: Wall-clock Unix time and monotonic uptime, battery level/state, brightness, Low Power Mode, thermal state and memory headroom at phase/turn boundaries. Compare with trace timestamps; preserve any mismatch.
safeguards: Existing model hash, memory reserve, foreground-loss, OS memory-warning and serious/critical thermal cancellation remain. Power pilot additionally refuses charging/low-battery/non-nominal/LPM start; cancels on charging changes, battery <20%, LPM enabled. Foreground idle timer temporarily disabled and restored on finish.
analysis: Use time-weighted measured rates for the observed phases, report baseline-before and baseline-after separately, and verify charging state/coverage. Unequal-duration pilot phases are not a same-duration paired benchmark. Do not convert relative app scores into watts or short-run rates into battery life/answers per charge.
limitations: One exploratory run is not the proposed repeated same-duration baseline/workload pairs. Wireless Xcode connection and trace overhead remain present; this cannot characterize disconnected sleep. Harness UI and per-turn model reload/hash behavior may differ from eventual shipping implementation. Earlier stress thermal failure remains failed.
status: One unplugged pilot completed; see POWER-PILOT-RESULTS-2026-10-06.json. Eight-turn content/resource checks passed. Power protocol incomplete: late attachment captured only 52.95% of initial baseline. Preserve diagnostic rates without qualification or extrapolation. No automatic repeat.
